column2: ADMINISTRATION AND MANAGEMENT OF THE ZONES SL
65. (1) The administration and management of the affairs
of  the  Zones  SL  shall  be  vested  in  a  Board  (in  this  Part
referred to as the “Zones SL Board”).
(2)  The  Zones  SL  Board  shall,  for  the  purpose  of
administering  and  managing  the  affairs  of  the  Zones  SL,
exercise,  perform  and  discharge  the  powers,  duties  and
functions conferred, assigned or imposed on Zones SL, by
